structured_record_directory.heading: ### FC-X01-RACE-A-WINS · Two concurrent orders; A locks first
### FC-X02-RACE-B-WINS · Same race; B locks first
### FC-X03-UNKNOWN-AR · Required AR frontier unavailable
### FC-X04-REPLAY · Reserve commits and response is lost
### FC-X05-POLICY-CHANGED · Policy changes between reserve and final action
### FC-X06-EXCEPTION-CONSUME · Bounded exception is consumed once
### FC-X07-EXCEPTION-REVOKE-RACE · Revocation locks before Sales final action
### FC-X08-ACTION-WINS-REVOCATION · Sales final action commits before revocation
### FC-X09-RELEASE-REPLAY · Cancellation releases once
### FC-X10-PERMISSION-REVOKED · Read and write revocation are distinct
### FC-X11-NULL-ZERO-MODES · No legacy default for null or zero limit
### FC-X12-REMOTE-NONATOMIC · Remote participant cannot prove same Uow
### FC-X13-SETTLEMENT-NO-DOUBLE · Receipt cut-lag effect is absorbed into a named AR obligation successor
### FC-X14-CREDIT-NO-DOUBLE · Credit memo cut-lag effect is absorbed into net AR exactly once
### FC-X15-RESERVATION-ORDER-TRANSFER · Reservation delta transfers into one order lineage stage
### FC-X16-ORDER-TO-AR-TRANSFER · Invoice posting uses the typed FIN-AR final-post participant to transfer the same lineage
### FC-X17-CONFIRM-THEN-SHIP · SHIP rechecks existing exposure with zero delta
### FC-X18-PARTIAL-SHIP · Partial schedule ship is a zero-delta stage proof
### FC-X19-ORDER-INCREASE · Price/quantity increase reserves only the positive delta
### FC-X20-CANCEL-AFTER-CONFIRM · Typed Sales cancellation participant reduces lineage without overloading a public credit action
### FC-X21-CONCURRENT-LATER-ACTIONS · Increase and ship serialize on one lineage head
### FC-X22-RESERVATION-DISJOINT · AR cut excludes reservation rows; snapshot adds disjoint sets
### FC-X23-C05-LOST-RESPONSE · C05 persistent evaluation terminal receipt recovers after loss
### FC-X24-C05-KEY-CONFLICT · C05 same key/different body is rejected
### FC-X25-C05-COMPLETE-CUT-SUCCESSOR · UNKNOWN evaluation gains immutable complete-cut successor
### FC-X26-C05-READ-REVOKED · C05 terminal exists but disclosure is revoked
### FC-X27-BP-I02-EXACT · Accepted BP I02 is called losslessly inside Sales Uow
### FC-X28-ATP-SUBJECT-BOUND · Fenced ATP observation binds exact subject input digest
### FC-X29-CUTOVER-ACTIVATE · Activation waits for old writers then flips epoch atomically
### FC-X30-CUTOVER-OLD-WRITER-RACE · Old writer arrives after activation
### FC-X31-CUTOVER-ROLLBACK-ALLOWED · Rollback is allowed only before any new effect
### FC-X32-CUTOVER-ROLLBACK-FORBIDDEN · Rollback after a new effect is denied
### FC-X33-CUTOVER-LOST-OLD-RESPONSE · Old committed command survives cutover via permanent tombstone
### FC-X34-RECEIPT-TWO-INVOICES · One accepted D25 receipt basis is allocated by two distinct D14 lines and D13 invoice events
### FC-X35-PARTIAL-UNAPPLY-SUCCESSOR · Accepted full D15 unapply plus D13 restoration creates a typed immutable effect successor before a smaller replacement allocation
### FC-X36-CROSS-CURRENCY-ALLOCATION · Cross-currency D14/D13 receipt reduction retains original Money and exact FX evidence
### FC-X37-SALES-REDUCTION-PARTICIPANT · Typed Sales cancellation/reduction participant has a lossless terminal replay payload
### FC-X38-AR-FINAL-POST-PARTICIPANT · Typed FIN-AR final-post participant has a lossless terminal replay payload
### FC-X39-COMPOSITE-LOCK-ORDER · Six path-specific plans use exact accepted BP coordinates and S/X modes in fixed class runs
### FC-X40-LEGACY-ADOPTION-COMPLETE · One legacy order with two schedule entries has separate complete order and entry coverage
### FC-X41-LEGACY-ADOPTION-UNKNOWN · Incomplete second schedule entry blocks adoption of the otherwise known legacy order
### FC-X42-ADMIN-PREPARE-LOST-RESPONSE · Cutover PREPARE commit loss is recovered under the common principal-bound command receipt
### FC-X43-ADMIN-ACTIVATE-LOST-RESPONSE · Cutover ACTIVATE commit loss returns the exact ACTIVE guard receipt
### FC-X44-ADMIN-ROLLBACK-LOST-RESPONSE · Eligible cutover ROLLBACK commit loss returns exact successor epoch receipt
### FC-X45-SIX-POLICY-CLASSIFICATIONS · Policy evaluates all six independent classifications with rule, original Money, FX and age evidence

CANONICAL then SCOPE (all warehouse ancestors before location children, stable owner/key within equal depth) then DETAIL ordinal owner/key; exact same registered database locks; strongest mode before acquisition

Each PUR_RETURN DETAIL/PROJECTION key exclusively protects the unique full-to-compact ProjectionBinding and its reverse mapping. Full original current heads are separate explicit Owner keys; DETAIL/PERMIT cannot substitute them. Full current-input resource protects businessDigest/sourceSetDigest/subjectDigest and original ParentPermit binding.

Stock CLAIM-RANGE and OUT PACK-COVERAGE are registered exact-root-range predicate locks shared by every relevant insertion/update path, including currently empty sets. PackageAssignment locks the immutable membership/content-digest set; the concrete member Package b3000000-0000-4000-8000-000000001300 row is explicitly enlisted before ALLOW. Any additional member requires its own collected Package key. Missing registration or newly discovered unlocked members require rollback/recollect, not a hidden lock.

QUALITY purpose resource is the current exact SUPPLIER_RETURN/SHIP gate; retained ACCEPTED90 alone is insufficient. All listed current Owner views must be re-read and permit the exact action under this same Uow. The illustrative expected revisions do not establish actual deployment.
Root/Pool revision2 are this reset DEMO branch after GR Quality application; START has Work2/Guard1 and EXECUTE Work3/Guard2; resulting Stock ledger/pool3 is the later committed effect.

Source LOCATION reduction holds CapacityDomain, CapacityHead, root occupancy/mapping, current metric-set and capacity-rule resources. 100 KG confirmed plus 0 unreceived becomes 90 KG confirmed plus 0 after SHIP10 EA at exact 1 KG/EA. Unreceived bindings are not consumed again. Missing metrics/coverage blocks final ALLOW.

This exact registry explicitly holds both SCOPE/WAREHOUSE and SCOPE/LOCATION. Deployment ancestor expansion is enumerated before lock acquisition; additional actual Site/ancestor scopes, packages or destinations require concrete extra resources. No composite-key hidden expansion or missing warehouse ancestor is allowed. Destination target, authorized destination, consignee and address current controls are explicit detail resources.

R1 v1.4 adds destination-before-approval DAG, PhysicalFact-before-Source/MRX DAG, permanent rejected closure and explicit warehouse ancestors. Retains the concrete Package row resource (SEALED2 at START, ASSIGNED3 at EXECUTE), with stable packagingIdentity for the complete OUT companion flow. Retains explicit full Approval/Agreement current heads, GR ScopeSet/domain/acceptance, Quality purpose, PLM/Master, full producer projection indexes, MRX/forward adoption, Stock canonical/occurrence/claim-range and OUT work/package resources; START and EXECUTE bind actual phase revisions. structured_sections.method: Every complete type object or every full recursive delta from an already read type displayed and semantically read;195roundtrip exact.

x-cp6-invariants: activeClaimQty is measure of the occupied claim union A
authorizedQty equals occupied claim quantity for the proven cut; receivedQty and creditedQty are subset/independent axes and are not added to authorizedQty
remainingAuthorizableQty = measure(eligible union E) - measure(occupied union A)
requestedRanges are pairwise disjoint and within originalSnapshot.sourceShareRanges
requestedQuantity.value equals exact measure(requestedRanges) in originalSnapshot.baseQty.uom
sourceCutRef/sourceVersionRef are mandatory eligibility evidence and CAS inputs, but a new source version cannot create another coordinate or bypass occupied claims
claimRanges nonempty, pairwise disjoint and subset of coordinate.eligibleRanges
claimedQuantity equals exact measure(claimRanges) in coordinate.baseUom
occupied states are ACTIVE_RESERVED, CONSUMED_BY_RECEIPT, UNKNOWN_HOLD
may be created only in the same Uow as an APPROVED AuthorizationDecision
ranges and quantity byte-semantically equal the referenced ReturnRangeClaim
partitions contain each of ACCEPTED, REJECTED, HOLD, PENDING exactly once
partition ranges are pairwise disjoint and their union equals effective scope after subtracting voidRanges
voidRanges are source-correction exclusions, not a quality state
